fixtureEvolution: The initial thirteen checks reproduced nine failures. Four further boundary/type/Scene-admission checks expanded the corrected suite to seventeen. The final asset check also verifies all 256 green pixels.

timing.scope: Five samples of ten 1024x1024 captures, after three warmups. Includes PNG encoding and fixture JSON roundtrip validation; local Editor Built-in/Direct3D12, not standalone gameplay.
timing.conclusion: No established latency improvement across runs. The code removes a redundant CPU-to-GPU Apply upload; readback still synchronizes with the GPU.

compatibility.toolInvocation: Direct core tools provide image blocks on both servers. The released advanced proxy returns JSON for these core tools; current proxy image checks also passed during fixture development.
compatibility.defaults: 512x512 and Camera.main when name omitted/empty retained; successful response fields preserved.
compatibility.changedInvalidBehavior: Explicit missing cameras and invalid/oversized/fractional dimensions now return errors instead of silently falling back, rounding or allocating.
compatibility.oldUnityRuntime: Deferred by maintainer direction; no old editor launched for this checkpoint.

minimumVersionCompile.check: C# compilation against installed Unity assemblies; no editor execution or package import

limits: Only Built-in rendering and Direct3D12 on Windows Unity 6000.6.2f1 were exercised here; URP/HDRP and other graphics APIs remain unverified.
Largest dimensions are checked before missing-camera lookup; no maximum-size image is allocated.
Stable texture object counts are within each warmed run, not a total GPU/process-memory measurement or a comparison of Unity cache size between runs.
Composed Game View, screen-space overlay UI, duplicate/inactive camera selection and file-based Game screenshot are separate work.
Asset preview still uses existing synchronous retry/loading and native preview dimensions.
